title: Try, try again
hints: You need three layers: `retry(times, on)` returns `decorate(fn)`, which returns `wrapper(*args, **kwargs)`. Validate `times` in the outermost layer, so it fails at decoration time.

Inside `wrapper`, loop over the attempt numbers. `try: return fn(*args, **kwargs)`, and in `except on:` either re-raise with a bare `raise` (if this was the last attempt) or carry on to the next attempt.
